Statistical indicators characterizing the generation of electrical and electronic equipment waste (WEEE) were calculated by Belstat in accordance with the Methodology for Calculating Statistical Indicators Characterizing the Generation of Electrical and Electronic Equipment Waste, developed following the E-waste Statistics: Guidelines for Classification, Reporting, and Indicators, prepared under the United Nations University’s Sustainable Cycles program and approved by the resolution of the National Statistical Committee of the Republic of Belarus dated March 25, 2022, No. 9. More detailed results on the calculation of statistical indicators characterizing WEEE generation in Belarus can be found on the Belstat website.
